title: deployment.response
description: Response to a coolify deployment.request (issue #97). `result` never claims success from an accepted-but-unreconciled async Coolify deployment (docs/coolify-adapter.md 'never treat timeout as success', mirroring AGENTS.md 3): `accepted` means Coolify queued the deployment (its ApplicationDeploymentQueue is `queued`/`in_progress`); OMES only reports `applied`/`healthy` after a subsequent status/health read confirms it. `external.deployment_uuid` is Coolify's own deployment identifier (from POST /deploy or POST /applications/{uuid}/rollback) and is the value used as `rollback_ref` on a later rollback request.
